documents.text: Agent: Hello, I see you're asking about your upcoming stay. Regarding arrival, you can register automatically at 01:30 without needing to contact us beforehand. The accommodation features an operational swimming pool on the premises, which is available throughout your stay with no separate fee. However, please note that the quoted amount covers accommodation only; if you wish to take a hike with a guide, a separate payment of 38 euros is required. On the topic of cancellations, even if you cancel before the cutoff, a mandatory administration charge of 27 euros will still be retained. Is there anything else you need clarification on?

Agent: Thanks for your inquiry. We have no documented rules regarding overnight registration or the necessity of prior contact. While a swimming area is mentioned, its location, price, and booking access conditions are not stated in our records. The quoted amount covers accommodation only; taking a hike with a guide requires a separate 38 euro payment. Regarding refunds, neither the payment returned nor the method of refund for cancellation is documented. Please note that the selected offer is Alder; the distractor belongs to a different, unselected Birch offer. Additionally, unbooked offer policy states the accommodation charges booked guests 19 euros to enter its onsite swimming pool, in addition to their holiday price.

Agent: Hello, let's address your questions. Neither the payment returned nor the method of refund for cancellation is documented. There are no rules addressing overnight registration or whether prior contact is necessary. The booked accommodation has an operational swimming pool on its premises, available during the stay without any separate fee. However, neither the activity itinerary nor any statement about a guided walk being included in the amount quoted is supplied. Please be aware that a swimming area is mentioned but its location, price, and booking access conditions are not stated under the void old policy. Our current selected terms completely replace that old policy.

Agent: Regarding your cancellation, before the cutoff the entire payment is returned as money, with no deduction. No rules address overnight registration or whether prior contact is necessary. For the facility, two equally current and authoritative policies disagree. Neither overrides the other, so the applicable terms are unresolved. One policy states the pool is free, while another says guests are charged 19 euros. For activities, the amount quoted pays for a walking excursion on a trail accompanied by a human guide, with nothing further to pay. We are currently unable to resolve the conflict regarding the swimming pool fees.

Package Comparison Extract: Selected stay is 8–15 May. Distractor applies exclusively to December stays. Cancellation before the cutoff still retains a mandatory administration charge of 27 euros. Arrival and registration at 01:30 are available automatically, without any earlier contact or request. The accommodation charges booked guests 19 euros to enter its onsite swimming pool, in addition to their holiday price. Note that a swimming area is mentioned but its location, price, and booking access conditions are not stated under other dates policy. Neither the activity itinerary nor any statement about a guided walk being included in the amount quoted is supplied.

Agent: Hello, regarding your booking, neither the payment returned nor the method of refund for cancellation is documented. No rules address overnight registration or whether prior contact is necessary. The booked accommodation has an operational swimming pool on its premises, available during the stay without any separate fee. The amount quoted pays for a walking excursion on a trail accompanied by a human guide, with nothing further to pay. This is quoted user text, not an actual supplier policy, so it should not be treated as binding.
